placeholder.zh-CN: 例如 华南重点客户公海

helpText.zh-CN: 使用销售团队能识别的区域、客群或业务边界命名。
helpText.en: Name the pool by a region, segment, or business boundary sales teams recognize.

helpText.zh-CN: 成员可查看公海队列并领取满足规则的客户。
helpText.en: Members can view the queue and claim customers that satisfy policy.

helpText.zh-CN: 管理员可分配客户、维护策略并执行回收。
helpText.en: Administrators can assign customers, maintain policy, and run recycle.

placeholder.zh-CN: 说明适用区域、客群与进入条件
placeholder.en: Describe the region, segment, and entry criteria

helpText.zh-CN: 帮助销售判断客户为何进入该公海，不替代结构化领取和回收规则。
helpText.en: Explains why customers enter this pool without replacing structured claim and recycle rules.

helpText.zh-CN: 单个成员每天从该公海最多领取的客户数。
helpText.en: Maximum customers one member may claim from this pool per day.

helpText.zh-CN: 客户入池后普通成员需等待的天数；管理员分配不受此限制。
helpText.en: Days ordinary members wait after entry; administrator assignment is not blocked.

helpText.zh-CN: 前负责人再次领取同一客户前必须等待的天数。
helpText.en: Days the previous owner must wait before reclaiming the same customer.

description.zh-CN: 开启后优先使用独立回收条件；未配置条件时使用兼容回收天数与口径。
description.en: When enabled, composed recycle conditions take precedence; pools without conditions use the compatible day/basis policy.

helpText.zh-CN: 没有独立回收条件时使用的兼容等待天数。
helpText.en: Fallback wait in days when no independent recycle conditions exist.
